description: Source code for the MenuContentView SwiftUI view managing the menu interface for the OpenClaw macOS application, including UI elements, state management, microphone handling, and debug actions.

classes.name: MenuContent
classes.description: SwiftUI view struct for the menu content, handling UI layout, state bindings, microphone management, and debug actions.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: Struct representing a microphone device with a unique ID and name.

methods.name: loadMicrophones
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers and loads available audio input devices (microphones) and updates the state.

methods.name: saveBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Saves the browser control enabled state to persistent storage.

methods.name: buildAndSaveBrowserEnabled
methods.description: Builds the configuration and saves the browser enabled setting, returning success status.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the specified settings tab and activates the main app window.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Asynchronously opens the dashboard URL in the default web browser; shows an alert if unavailable.

methods.name: presentDebugResult
methods.description: Displays a modal alert with the result of a debug action.
